diagnosis: Major thermal burn involving over 30% of the total body surface area.
notes: Nutritional assessment shows a hypermetabolic state with markedly increased calorie and protein requirements.
description: Nutritional status assessment in a major burn patient.

diagnosis: Post-operative monitoring following major reconstructive flap surgery.
notes: Nutritional assessment shows adequate protein intake with satisfactory wound-healing parameters.
description: Nutritional status monitoring after major reconstructive surgery.

diagnosis: Chronic non-healing wound planned for major flap reconstruction.
notes: Preoperative nutritional assessment shows mild hypoalbuminemia requiring optimization before major flap surgery.
description: Preoperative nutritional assessment before flap surgery.

diagnosis: Major scald burn in a child requiring intensive nutritional support.
notes: Nutritional assessment shows an increased caloric requirement consistent with the hypermetabolic response to burn injury.
description: Nutritional status assessment in a paediatric burn patient.

diagnosis: Post-operative monitoring following extensive skin grafting for a chronic ulcer.
notes: Nutritional assessment shows a borderline protein-energy status; dietary supplementation advised.
description: Nutritional status monitoring after skin grafting surgery.

diagnosis: Major thermal burn undergoing fluid resuscitation.
notes: Serum electrolytes show mild hyponatremia with potassium within the normal range, consistent with ongoing fluid resuscitation.
description: Serum electrolyte monitoring during burn fluid resuscitation.

diagnosis: Extensive burn injury in the post-resuscitation phase.
notes: Serum electrolytes show a mild upward trend in potassium attributed to tissue catabolism, being closely monitored.
description: Serum electrolyte monitoring in the post-resuscitation phase of burn management.

diagnosis: Preoperative assessment before major flap reconstruction surgery.
notes: Serum electrolytes are within normal limits; patient fit for major reconstructive surgery.
description: Perioperative serum electrolyte assessment before reconstructive surgery.

diagnosis: Major burn injury in a child undergoing fluid resuscitation.
notes: Serum electrolytes show mild hyponatremia; fluid therapy adjusted accordingly.
description: Serum electrolyte monitoring in a paediatric burn patient.

diagnosis: Post-operative monitoring following extensive skin grafting surgery.
notes: Serum electrolytes show a mild metabolic derangement, corrected with intravenous fluid adjustment.
description: Postoperative serum electrolyte assessment after skin grafting.

diagnosis: Superficial partial-thickness burn of the hand.
notes: Burn dressing performed with a non-adherent dressing and splinting to maintain a functional hand position.
description: Burn dressing for superficial partial-thickness burn of the hand.

diagnosis: Deep dermal burn of the forearm.
notes: Burn dressing performed after debridement of loose slough, with a silver-based dressing applied.
description: Burn dressing for deep dermal burn of the forearm.

diagnosis: Mixed-depth flame burn of the trunk.
notes: Burn dressing performed with careful assessment of wound depth and appropriate dressing selection across the mixed-depth areas.
description: Burn dressing for mixed-depth flame burn of the trunk.

diagnosis: Scald burn of the lower limb.
notes: Burn dressing performed with cleaning of the wound bed and application of a hydrocolloid dressing.
description: Burn dressing for scald burn of the lower limb.

diagnosis: Partial-thickness burn of the face.
notes: Burn dressing performed with a light non-adherent dressing, with care taken to preserve periorbital and perioral function.
description: Burn dressing for partial-thickness burn of the face.

diagnosis: Circumferential full-thickness burn of the limb with vascular compromise.
notes: Escharotomy performed along the medial and lateral aspects of the limb to relieve compartment pressure and restore distal perfusion.
description: Escharotomy for circumferential full-thickness limb burn.

diagnosis: Compartment syndrome following burn injury with rising compartment pressure.
notes: Fasciotomy performed with a longitudinal incision and release of the affected muscle compartments.
description: Fasciotomy for post-burn compartment syndrome.

diagnosis: Traumatic soft tissue defect of the leg following a degloving injury requiring flap cover.
notes: Flap reconstruction performed using a local fasciocutaneous flap to provide durable soft tissue cover.
description: Flap reconstruction for traumatic soft tissue defect.

diagnosis: Post-burn contracture of the neck.
notes: Contracture release performed with excision of the scar band and coverage using a full-thickness skin graft.
description: Release of post-burn neck contracture.

diagnosis: Post-burn contracture of the axilla.
notes: Contracture release performed with Z-plasty and skin grafting to restore shoulder abduction.
description: Release of post-burn axillary contracture.

diagnosis: Post-burn contracture of the hand.
notes: Contracture release performed with excision of the scar band and split-thickness skin grafting to restore finger extension.
description: Release of post-burn hand contracture.

diagnosis: Raw area post-burn requiring skin cover.
notes: Split-thickness skin grafting performed to cover the raw area following burn wound debridement.
description: Skin grafting for raw area post-burn.

diagnosis: Raw area post-excision of a soft tissue lesion requiring skin cover.
notes: Split-thickness skin grafting performed to cover the raw area following excision of the lesion.
description: Skin grafting for raw area post-excision of soft tissue lesion.

diagnosis: Extensive raw area post-burn requiring skin cover.
notes: Meshed split-thickness skin grafting performed to achieve wide coverage of the raw area.
description: Skin grafting for extensive raw area post-burn.
